title: Kyler Murray and J.J. McCarthy will split first-team reps as QB battle continues into Vikings camp

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Kyler Murray and J.J. McCarthy will split first-team reps as QB battle continues into Vikings camp
sources.description: Head coach Kevin O'Connell met with each of his quarterbacks as they reported to camp this week to explain his vision and plan for managing snaps and determining who will start Week 1.
